description: This file implements a thread worker pool in C++, managing worker threads, task posting, and thread count determination based on system configuration.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: A class managing a pool of worker threads for executing tasks asynchronously.

methods.name: GetThreadCount
methods.description: Determines the optimal number of worker threads based on system configuration and command line switches.

methods.name: WorkerPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker pool with a default or specified number of threads.

methods.name: PostTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the worker pool for execution.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Function run by each thread to process tasks from the queue.
